bayCreek.source: baycreekhomes.com/properties/ — the community's own listing index, fetched 2026-08-12
bayCreek.sourceCaveat: This is an INDEX page, not eleven property-detail pages. Address, price, beds, baths, sqft and an Active status all come from that index. Nobody has opened a detail page for these, so treat status and price as one-source until they are.
bayCreek.theCatch: Bay Creek's Membership Plan requires each purchaser of a residence OR homesite in the "New Community" to take at least a Sports Membership and pay the joining fee on or before closing. With the POA at roughly $2,100/yr, real carry is about $4,400-4,500/yr plus a five-figure entry. Several MLS listings claim membership is optional; the Membership Plan says otherwise. Settle this per-parcel before an offer.
bayCreek.whatIsGood: Every one of these sits on a golf-course street — Palmer Dr is the Arnold Palmer course. Bay Creek is gated, has a private 2-mile beach, pool, Coach House Tavern clubhouse, Life Center, tennis and pickleball, 350 acres of trails, and 27 holes of golf. Cape Charles itself is golf-cart legal on streets at 25 mph or under, and Bay Creek publishes a cart path into town.
bayCreek.drive: ~2h10 from Glen Allen — outside the 2-hour radius, searched deliberately anyway.
